historical_record.description: The Chateau Apartments, designed in the Chateauesque style by Douglas D. Stone of Stone & Mulloy.

hook: A seven-story building of 1929 whose 64 apartments are held as 64 separate condominium parcels.

narrative.lead: 2701 Van Ness Avenue is a seven-story building of 1929 whose 64 apartments are held as 64 separate condominium parcels — lots 031 through 094 on block 0503 — numbered 201 through 711, ten or eleven to a floor from the second floor up; the roll records no residential unit on the ground floor.

unknowns: The Chateau Apartments are credited to Herman C. Baumann in 1929 and to Douglas D. Stone in 1930 by two volumes of the same citywide collection of professional biographies.
The roll gives this building's units more than one year built: 1 of them 1927, 63 of them 1929.
